title: Contract review + redline negotiation
description: Review an agreement against a supplied playbook, merge clause positions, and require counsel approval.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: contract-review-redline-negotiation
  title: Contract review + redline negotiation
  description: Review an agreement against a supplied playbook, merge clause positions, and require counsel approval.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a traceable redline package without making unsupervised legal decisions.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [counsel-approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: agreement
      kind: input
      name: Agreement and playbook
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [asset, instructions]
        properties:
          asset: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/pdf }
          instructions: { type: string }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: analyze
      kind: agent
      name: Map clause departures
      templateRef: legal-01
      role: Contract analyst who maps clauses to a supplied playbook without giving unsupervised legal advice.
      prompt: Review the supplied agreement clause by clause. Identify departures from the supplied playbook, quote the controlling language, explain the operational consequence, and route legal judgments to qualified counsel.
      capabilities:
        skills: [contract-analysis, evidence-grounding]
        tools: [read, annotate]
        connectors: [mcp:document-editor]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          contract-analysis:
            template: contract-analysis
            instructions: Treat the supplied playbook as the only approved position source and preserve clause citations.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: negotiate
      kind: agent
      name: Draft bounded fallback positions
      templateRef: legal-02
      role: Negotiation analyst who drafts bounded fallback positions from an approved playbook.
      prompt: For each disputed clause, state the preferred position, approved fallbacks, business tradeoff, and escalation boundary. Never invent authority or accept a term outside the supplied mandate.
      capabilities:
        skills: [contract-negotiation, decision-framing]
        tools: [read, edit]
        connectors: [mcp:document-editor]
        permissions: [workspace-write]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: merge-positions
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge clause positions and surface collisions
      config: { aggregation: merge }
    - id: counsel-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Qualified counsel approves the redline package
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Approved redline package
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: agreement, to: analyze, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: agreement, to: negotiate, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: analyze, to: merge-positions, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: negotiate, to: merge-positions, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: merge-positions, to: counsel-approval, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e6, from: counsel-approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
